capabilities: Search the official plugin and theme directory by name, author or ID
Install and enable a plugin or theme in one click
Download files through several GitHub mirrors with SHA-256 verification
Check installed official plugins for stable updates
Browse the Obsidian Chinese forum and sign in to like or reply
extras: Only plugins and themes already listed in the official community directory are supported; mirror availability and speed vary, and a latency test in settings can be re-run when all nodes fail. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer. No telemetry or ads; forum sign-in keys are stored locally and can be revoked.
problem: In restricted networks the official community directory and GitHub downloads are often unreachable, so installing plugins and themes fails without a VPN.
summary: Installer for official Obsidian community plugins and themes that works on restricted networks via GitHub mirrors, with Chinese descriptions and update checks.
